text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
TM Opera O suddenly stopped in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun,
you remember the princess in pajamas, don't you?

The Pajama Princess... She must be talking about
that girl who snuck out of the hospital
because she was a fan of T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow is the day of her surgery.
choice_data_list: ...I wonder what I can say to cheer them up.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No need to overthink it. First thing tomorrow,
I'll just go deliver my smile to her!

And then, the next day.
I headed to the hospital with
TM Opera O, but—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me. Right now, she is—

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text: ...Are you really that scared of the surgery?

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: *hic*... *sniff*...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...My princess. Please, do not weep.
It feels as if your very eyes might spill over along with your tears.
Ah, let me be the one to embrace your sorrow."

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: O-Opera O...!?

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... *sniff*, I-I'm so sorry...!
I twied so hard to do it, but...
Even so... I ran awaaaay...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: My princess...

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
I... I really can't be like...
Opera O...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, my princess.
Isn't that only natural?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: After all, I am a one-of-a-kind existence! ...However!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I shall tell you!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My name is T.M. Opera O!
The one who shall become the "Overlord of the Century's End"!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O lovely Princess in Pajamas! Fear not!
For I know the true extent of your strength!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Opera O...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My friend! Are her tears a sign of weakness or not?!
Please, tell me what they mean!

—The meaning behind those tears.
Though caught off guard by the question,
I understand what that precious meaning is.

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Brave...? Even though you're crying?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"That's right!
Tears are the courage to face what lies ahead!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is not weakness...
It is the manifestation of a spirit fighting to break through the status quo!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, stand tall, my princess!
And let us face the challenge together!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: To that dragon!!!!!

T.M. Opera O is looking right at me...
It seems she's decided
"You are the Dragon."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That dragon is your weakness!
Now, let's settle this with your own hands!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Y... Yeah! But how?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You must have a weapon.
One that holds the most dazzling light—

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: ! ...A hand mirror!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Now, point that mirror at the dragon!
Holy feelings shall shatter any monster to pieces!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
…………
……*whimper*.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "...Dragon-kun! It's your turn!"

And so, the dragon was
slain by the girl.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: My princess, do you no longer require my escort?

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I can... I can do this on my own!
I'm not running away anymore!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, until we meet again,
my lovely and courageous princess.
choice_data_list: ...I'm truly no match for Opera O.
...I just can't compete with Opera O.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine if you couldn't match me.
You played quite a convincing dragon, you know?"

Later on, a letter arrived from the girl.
She wrote that her surgery went well, returned the hand mirror,
and then—

"Next time, I'll deliver it wearing a dress."
...was what was written.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed! Those tears are of frustration, of regret!
Tears shed only by those who yearn to move forward!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And that is why your tears shine so brightly!
As you desperately struggle to grasp hold of hope!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: ...Operao...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Struggling is the very strength needed to forge ahead into the future!
Come, my princess! Let us face this challenge!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: We're gonna defeat that Demon King of Darkness!

T.M. Opera O is looking right at me...
It seems she's decided
"You are the Dark Lord."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Demon Lord of Darkness is your fear!
Show that one who seeks to block your path
the strength of your will to press forward!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Y... Yeah! But how?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You must have a weapon.
One that holds the most dazzling light—

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: ! ...A hand mirror!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Now, point that mirror at the Demon King of Darkness!
Holy feelings shall shatter any monster to pieces!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O Demon Lord of Darkness... Behold the light held high by the princess!
Now shall it shine upon thee and bring peace to the world!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, nice one,
Trainer-kun.
"And so, the Demon Lord of Darkness was vanquished by the girl."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: My princess, do you no longer require my escort?

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I can... I can do this on my own!
I'm not running away anymore!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, until we meet again,
my lovely and noble princess.
choice_data_list: A Demon Lord of Darkness, huh...
So I'm the Demon Lord of Darkness, huh...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Come now, please don't be upset.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"A Demon King is still a 'King,' just like an Overlord.
We ought to be quite compatible."

Later on, a letter arrived from the girl.
She wrote that her surgery went well, returned the hand mirror,
and then—

"Next time, I'll deliver it wearing a dress."
...was what was written.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Indeed. To hesitate is the destiny of all living things! My princess! It is precisely because you hesitate and struggle that you can grow stronger!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Worrying... makes you strong...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! And thus, your own path is forged!
Therefore, it is perfectly fine if it differs from mine!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: My path...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, stand tall, my princess!
And let us face the challenge together!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Defeat that mist demon clouding your path!

T.M. Opera O is looking right at me...
It seems she's decided
"You are the Djinn of the Mist."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That mist demon is all the fear you've held onto until now!
Let's settle this with your own hands!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Y... Yeah! But how?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You must have a weapon.
One that holds the most dazzling light—

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: ! ...A hand mirror!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Now, point that mirror at the Djinn of the Mist!
Holy feelings shall shatter any monster to pieces!
choice_data_list: You think you can break me~?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My princess! Do not look away!
It's all right, I know you can do it!!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: Ugh... uuu... aw, heck with it!

And so, the Mist Fiend
was defeated by the girl.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: My princess, do you no longer require my escort?

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I can... I can do this on my own!
I'm not running away anymore!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, until we meet again,
my lovely and sincere princess.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—A radiant light illuminates the path for others.
However, each person must walk that path themselves.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You and I are the only ones
who can walk our Victory Road... Trainer.

Later on, a letter arrived from the girl.
She wrote that her surgery went well, returned the hand mirror,
and then—

"Next time, I'll deliver it wearing a dress."
...was what was written.
